rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for noticing or becoming aware of something.

example.english: I didn't perceive that I'd forgotten my keys until I got home.
example.traditional: 我返到屋企先發覺自己冇帶鎖匙。
example.jyutping: ngo5 faan2 dou3 uk1 kei2 sin1 faat3 gok3 zi6 gei2 mou5 daai3 so2 si4

rows.note: Use this when the awareness comes specifically through a physical sensation or sense.

example.english: I perceive a wave of heat as soon as I walk near the stove.
example.traditional: 我一行近個爐就感覺到一陣熱氣。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 hang4 gan6 go3 lou4 zau6 gam2 gok3 dou3 jat1 zan6 jit6 hei3

rows.note: Use this when interpreting or regarding A as B, as in regarding someone as a coward.

example.english: They always perceive me as a child and never let me decide anything for myself.
example.traditional: 佢成日當我係細路，乜都唔畀我自己決定。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dong3 ngo5 hai6 sai3 lou6 mat1 dou1 m4 bei2 ngo5 zi6 gei2 kyut3 ding6
